lines: Only the things I lost ever gained a price
It always changed within time
Why does it have to be like this! All ganging up on me like that!
But no matter how many times, it wears me down
A monster, or a demon of the night
I fight things that never even appear
It was too late, so I ran at full speed
Though I was sighing all the while
Farewell, the days when being normal was pain
When I wave my hand, look—now
You're right beside me
We walk on together, failing as we go
Farewell, through the streets as they change
Let's walk on, take the long way home
Scattered stars and a beer gone flat
The rules of common sense, always changing
I said it drunk, I said it carried away
But the words alone stay to be answered for
Things like curses you can't see
I fight them only once I've noticed them
Even if it's too late, the road I chose myself
Is the one I want to keep going down
Farewell, the days I spilled out with "I'm exhausted"
When I wave my hand, look—now
You're right beside me
Even the troublesome things, we face together
Farewell, through the streets as they change
Let's walk on, take the long way home
Like a bouquet filling both my hands
That it's all right to accept happiness
That there's nothing to fear
I found myself thinking, there beside you
Farewell, the days when being normal was pain
When I wave my hand, look—now
You're right beside me
We walk on together, failing as we go
Farewell, through the streets as they change
Let's walk on, take the long way home
